---
# Render via `targets::tar_make()` (the `render_manuscript` target in
# _targets.R), not `quarto render` directly - see manuscript.qmd.
#
# Blank starting point for a real appendix - static, journal-supplement-
# style content (no R execution), as distinct from supplementary/*.qmd's
# "notebooks with programmatic logic" (see _quarto.yml's Aesthetics/
# Infrastructure-vs-Appendices sidebar split). Copy this file, rename it,
# fill it in.
#
# To surface a new appendix in the site navigation, add it under the
# "Appendices" section's `contents:` in _quarto.yml.
title: "Appendix Template"
---

```{r}
#| label: setup
#| include: false
# Needed even though an appendix may have no R content of its own -
# _back-to-manuscript.qmd's include below has a hidden chunk that calls
# here::here("R/functions.R"), and here() needs *this* document's own
# i_am() call to anchor correctly - confirmed by direct testing: this
# renders fine under tar_quarto() (cwd = repo root there always masks a
# missing anchor) but fails under a direct `quarto render` from inside
# manuscript/ without it. Every notebook/appendix needs this, "no R code"
# or not - update the path below to match this file's new name/location.
here::i_am("manuscript/appendices/appendix-template.qmd")
```

{{< include ../supplementary/_back-to-manuscript.qmd >}}

Static content with no R code goes here - extended methods, a
questionnaire, raw supporting text - material that belongs with the
manuscript but doesn't need `targets`/knitr to produce it. For an
appendix that *does* run R code, start from
[Notebook Template](../supplementary/notebook-template.qmd) instead, and
consider whether it actually belongs under Appendices or Aesthetics/
Infrastructure in the sidebar.
